<div class="feature-header">
<h2>About Me</h2>

Hi I'm Ford! I’m curious by nature, always asking questions and exploring patterns-whether in the world around me or in the data I work with. With a background in Sociology and a self-taught passion for analytics, I enjoy uncovering insights that tell a story and make complex information feel clear and actionable. Colleagues know me as reliable, detail-oriented, and someone who approaches problems with both curiosity and care.

Outside of work, you’ll often find me hiking new trails, capturing moments through photography, trying to improve my golf game, or spending time with my family. I like to approach life the same way I approach data: with curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to learn from every experience.

</div>
